description: Hello! SPX145 is a small team from Antalya, Türkiye: one student developer and a mentor. The team builds a simulation about surviving beyond Earth: in Moon Base Commander, players run a base on the Moon or Mars and balance power, water, oxygen, food and radiation protection. The student developer designed the rules, tested every mission and made the presentations; the mentor checked the science and the rules. New members in Antalya are welcome!
